title.narrative: Activity under preparation Investing in resilience and inclusive socio-economic growth in Georgia

description.narrative: The goal of this action is to invest in resilience and inclusive socio-economic growth that will improve the living conditions of Georgian citizens and to support Georgia¿s alignment process with EU standards and best practices in areas of mutual strategic interest. The following components are planned:Inclusive socio-economic growth through education, employment and social inclusion with a view to bridging gender and skills gaps and addressing territorial disparities while targeting the most disadvantaged people and communities. This should improve access to labour market and social protection; better matching skills with labour market; and an increase in women¿s participation in economic activities. Development and diversification of energy sources and especially renewables to help combat the effects of climate change. The action will include preparatory actions to accelerate the development and deployment of the Black Sea submarine electricity cable, supporting Georgia reaching its full potential in terms of production and export of green and renewable energy, and aligning with EU legislation in the electricity market (i.e. unbundling the power utility).Support to the delivery of the consolidated migration package and implementation of the national Migration Strategy for 2021-2030 for the fulfillment of the visa liberalisation benchmarks and addressing the root cause of migration. It will address the Commission¿s recommendations in the reports under the visa suspension mechanism, in particular the issue of unfounded asylum applications.Continuation of support to Georgia¿s participation in selected EU programmes.Strategic communication to continue to inform the public in Georgia about the EU and what the integration path entails, and further improve awareness about the EU's support to Georgia in the context of the people of Georgia¿s aspiration to join the EU.  This programme will contribute to MIP 2021-2027 priorities 1 and 5 and to Team Europe Initiative ¿Balanced territorial development¿. The programme will also contribute to EIP objective to invest in people and knowledge societies with focus on human capital and to the implementation of the Country-Level Implementation Plan of the EU Gender Action Plan (GAP III) for Georgia 2021-2025.The Action contributes to the implementation of SDG 8 (sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all), SDG 4 (inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all, SDG 5 (gender equality and empower all women and girl), SDG 7 (access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all), SDG 10 (reduce inequality within and among countries) and SDG 11 (make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable).
